title: Compact retry adapter, typed stream iterators and SDK version pin
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Introduce compact RetryAdapter to centralize idempotent retry/backoff behavior across SDKs
Expose typed async/iterable stream helpers for safer streaming consumption in Python/TypeScript/Go
Pin SDK packages to v1.6.0-alpha to avoid transient dependency breakage during rollout
Add Idempotency-Key support on streaming-start requests to enable safe retries
No breaking API surface changes; ergonomic improvements only
description: Motivation: multiple SDKs had divergent retry logic for ephemeral streaming requests which led to inconsistent user experiences and repeated ad-hoc fixes. This PR introduces a compact RetryAdapter library (golang + shared interface used by each SDK), exposes lightweight typed stream iterators in Python/TypeScript/Go to reduce boilerplate when consuming server-sent events, and pins the SDK packages to v1.6.0-alpha for a controlled rollout. Summary of changes (single-string description): add internal/retry adapter with configurable policy (max_attempts, base_backoff_ms, jitter, idempotency header support) and a small circuit-breaker for repeated 429/503; python: add redwood.sdk.streams.TextStream and StreamEvent typing, expose .events() async iterator and convenience .read_text() for single-message flows; typescript: add StreamEvent<T> and createStreamIterator() helper returning AsyncIterable<StreamEvent<T>>; go: add stream.IterEvent typed channel helper and NewRetryAdapter constructor used by client.StreamStart; common: update proto/stream.proto to add optional start_idempotency_key (backwards compatible), bump docs and examples; test: add unit and e2e checks covering idempotent restart, jitter distribution, and typed iterator ergonomics. Testing and rollout: CI initially failed on a flaky python streaming test, rerun fixed; canary rollout of pinned SDKs to internal prod team for 48h before wide release. Backwards compatibility: streaming start adds an optional header/field; SDK helpers are additive and do not require callers to change. Checklist: [x] unit tests added for retry adapter and iterators; [x] integration test for transient 503->recover; [x] docs updated; [x] linear tickets referenced (ENG-4127, ENG-4139).
